items.t: Automatic transmission goes into limp mode or fails
items.note: KBB dealer price; a rebuilt or used unit from an independent shop usually costs less. Have the transmission computer tested at the same time.

items.t: Plastic radiator fan blades break apart
items.job: Replace radiator cooling fan and motor
items.note: Price is for one fan. Add more if the radiator, belts or hoses were damaged by flying pieces.

items.t: Plastic coolant pipes and flanges crack and leak
items.job: Replace cracked coolant hoses, pipes and flanges
items.note: Based on KBB radiator hose pricing. Replacing several aging plastic parts at once costs more but avoids repeat failures.

items.t: Timing chain sprocket wears and chain can jump
items.job: Replace timing chains, guides and intermediate sprocket
items.note: Engine damage from a jumped chain costs much more.

items.t: Driver airbag inflator may need replacing (recall)
Water pump impeller fails and engine runs hot

items.note: YourMechanic quotes for EuroVans vary widely by year; 12-valve vans use a coil pack that can cost more.

items.t: Brakes wear out quickly and squeal
items.job: Replace brake pads and rotors (one axle)
items.note: Pads alone cost about $95-$110 in parts per axle.

items.t: Camper fuel vapor container can be punctured (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace fuel vapor container (recall)

items.t: A/C compressor or blower motor fails
items.note: KBB lists independent shops at about $1,700-$1,865 total.

items.t: Child seat anchor instructions were wrong (recall)
